drafts.title: 2026高考志愿：AI时代专业选
drafts.body: 2026年高考志愿如何填？电气、能动、机械、医学、计算机，还是火爆的人工智能？我们不再只看专业名称，更要审视其背后的技术栈与未来产业应用。AI、大数据、物联网正重塑传统行业，赋能职业新可能。是时候打破专业壁垒，拥抱交叉学科，规划高增长潜力职业赛道！

drafts.title: 2026 College Major Selection: AI's Impact on Traditional & Emerging Fields
drafts.body: The 2026 college admissions landscape is evolving rapidly. Should students choose Electrical, Energy & Power Engineering, Mechanical, Medicine, Computer Science, or the booming field of Artificial Intelligence? This video dives deep into how AI, big data, and IoT are transforming traditional disciplines and creating new opportunities in interdisciplinary fields. We'll explore the importance of focusing on underlying tech stacks and future industry applications rather than just major names. Discover how to future-proof your career and navigate professional upgrades in the age of AI.

image_prompts.prompt: A diverse group of university students from different majors (e.g., engineering, medicine, computer science) collaboratively working on a project that integrates AI and robotics in a modern, well-lit lab. Focus on innovation and interdisciplinary teamwork. Composition: dynamic, showing students interacting with advanced tech. Lighting: bright, futuristic. Mood: collaborative, optimistic.

An abstract representation of data flowing through various professional fields like electrical grids, smart factories, and medical facilities, with AI symbols subtly integrated. The visual should convey transformation and interconnectedness. Composition: sweeping lines, holographic elements. Lighting: soft, glowing blues and greens. Mood: analytical, transformative.

A split image: one side showing a traditional scene (e.g., an older engineering blueprint, a classic medical textbook) and the other side showing its modern, AI-enhanced equivalent (e.g., a digital design interface, an AI-assisted diagnostic screen). Emphasize the evolution and upgrade. Composition: clear divide, balanced. Lighting: warm for traditional, cool for modern. Mood: progress, innovation.

A student looking thoughtfully at a holographic projection displaying various career paths and tech trends (AI, IoT, Big Data). The student is in a modern study environment, suggesting informed decision-making for future career planning. Composition: focused, showing interaction with technology. Lighting: soft ambient light, with a luminous projection. Mood: contemplative, aspirational.
